one_liner: systeme.io has a documented REST public API that uses a self-generated X-API-Key header, plus an official vendor-hosted MCP server. No OAuth is documented.
auth_notes: The official docs say the API key in the X-API-Key header is the only option. Users create up to 3 keys per account, optionally with an expiry. A Rollout guide describes an OAuth flow, but it is third-party and contradicts the official docs, so it was ignored.
access_notes: Keys are generated self-serve in account settings. The snippets don't say which plan tier is required. systeme.io is known to have a free plan, but this is not confirmed by the evidence.
blocker_notes: Each user must paste their own API key, because there is no OAuth. Rate limits are shared across all of a user's keys.

evidence.quote: To authenticate with the Systeme.io Public API, your only option right now is to attach your API key to the `X-API-Key` header of each request.
Scroll down to the Public API keys section and click **Create** (3).
